```{r}
#| echo: false
# This is crazy but seems to maybe work, inspired by https://github.com/r-lib/nanoparquet/blob/e881a75cf4930156625c4b728a17f3cc6cd86796/vignettes/articles/benchmarks.qmd#L22
br_path <- if (Sys.getenv("QUARTO_DOCUMENT_PATH") != "") {
  if (
    fs::dir_exists(fs::path(
      Sys.getenv("QUARTO_DOCUMENT_PATH"),
      "business_requirements"
    ))
  ) {
    fs::path(Sys.getenv("QUARTO_DOCUMENT_PATH"), "business_requirements")
  } else {
    fs::path(Sys.getenv("QUARTO_DOCUMENT_PATH"))
  }
} else if (fs::file_exists("business_requirements.yml")) {
  fs::path(getwd())
} else if (fs::file_exists("business_requirements/business_requirements.yml")) {
  fs::path("business_requirements")
} else if (
  fs::file_exists("articles/business_requirements/business_requirements.yml")
) {
  fs::path("articles/business_requirements")
} else {
  fs::path("vignettes/articles/business_requirements")
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
library(magrittr)
br_issue_number <- 518
brs <- yaml::read_yaml(fs::path(br_path, "business_requirements.yml"))
br <- purrr::keep(
  brs,
  ~ .x$issue == br_issue_number
)[[1]]

img_path <- fs::path(br_path, "img")
all_imgs <- fs::dir_ls(img_path, recurse = TRUE, type = "file", glob = "*.png")
all_imgs <- fs::path_rel(all_imgs, start = br_path)
names(all_imgs) <- fs::path_ext_remove(fs::path_file(all_imgs))
```

## Features & Bug Fixes

Explore the screenshot evidence presented here to determine if you agree that the app does what is described. If you do, go to the linked GitHub issue for that feature or bug fix, and comment with your approval.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
purrr::walk(br$features, function(feature) {
  callout_class <- "tip"
  if (stringr::str_starts(tolower(feature$title), "bug")) {
    callout_class <- "important"
  }

  feature_header <- glue::glue(
    ':::: {{.callout-{callout_class} collapse="true"}}',
    "## {feature$issue}: {feature$title}",
    "[GitHub issue](https://github.com/Gilead-BioStats/gsm.app/issues/{feature$issue})",
    .sep = "\n"
  )

  cat(paste(feature_header, "", sep = "\n"))

  purrr::iwalk(feature$acceptance_criteria, function(ac, i) {
    ac_header <- glue::glue(
      '::: {{.callout collapse="true"}}',
      "### {ac}",
      .sep = "\n"
    )

    cat(paste("", ac_header, "", sep = "\n"))
    ac_pad <- stringr::str_pad(i, width = 2, pad = "0")
    img_pattern <- glue::glue("^{feature$issue}-{ac_pad}-")
    relevant_img_names <- stringr::str_subset(names(all_imgs), img_pattern)

    if (length(relevant_img_names) > 0) {
      purrr::walk(relevant_img_names, function(img_name) {
        caption <- stringr::str_remove(img_name, "^(\\d+-)+") %>%
          stringr::str_replace_all(c("_" = " ", "-" = ": "))
        img_path <- all_imgs[[img_name]]
        cat(
          glue::glue("![{caption}]({img_path}){{.lightbox}}"),
          "",
          sep = "\n"
        )
      })
    }

    cat(':::\n\n')
  })

  cat('::::\n')
})
```
